name: smwsprites-yurarin-boo
title: Yurarin Boo
description:
A seahorse from Super Mario Land that jumps from water, spits a fireball, and stays behind layers. It can be stomped. Don't forget to enable sprite buoyancy for your level if using this sprite.

This sprite was part of smkdan's Super Mario Land sprites pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.
